svg.title: Подъём гантелей перед собой поочерёдно — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Alternating front dumbbell raise. Same realistic athlete stands in each frame from a 30-degree front three-quarter angle, with two individual dumbbells. LEFT frame: his anatomical RIGHT arm extends straight FORWARD to shoulder height with dumbbell in hand, and his LEFT arm hangs entirely straight at the LEFT thigh holding the other dumbbell. RIGHT frame: swap the roles exactly. Now his LEFT arm extends straight FORWARD to shoulder height, and his RIGHT arm hangs entirely straight at the RIGHT thigh. Elbows just soft. Stable body, no twisting, two obvious alternating raised arms and never a simultaneous raise. Forward reaches toward the direction the nose points, never sideways. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
